messages:
james-support: Heads-up — ACME (acct jess) just escalated: their customers are getting 400s for function/tool calls since we started the v3.1 canary. They say it only happens when the model variant is v3.1. Can someone look?

zoe-eng-ml: Thanks James. We rolled v3.1 canary ~5% traffic last night with a new tool-selection ranking tweak (score boost for recent tools).

lukas-eng-platform: Seeing related logs in routing: toolRouter returned tool_id=expense_lookup_v2 but the tool schema in the registry is expense_lookup_v1 -> mismatch leads to schema validation fail at runtime. Sample response from our runtime: 
```
{"error":"tool_call_failed","cause":"schema_validation","details":"expected arg 'user_id' string, got object"}
```

maya-support: @customer-acct-jess can you confirm if this reproduces on both hosted and dedicated? any filtering/proxy on their side?

customer-acct-jess: Hosted only so far, happening on prod for some customers. Repro steps below we sent: 
1) POST to /v1/chat with model=v3.1 and tool hint expense_lookup
2) payload: {"tool_args":{"id": {"value": 123}}} -> 400 schema reject

james-support: They included a curl repro: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
 -d '{"model":"v3.1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"find expense for user 123"}],"tools":["expense_lookup"]}'
```

ryan-eng-oncall: Alerts: p50 latency for function-enabled requests jumped from 120ms -> 420ms after v3.1 canary. Error rate for tool calls up ~0.8% -> 3.6% in the last 30m.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-457 - tool-calls: model-v3.1 routing regressions. Pager notified.

zoe-eng-ml: Hypothesis: the new ranking inadvertently prefers a v2 tool alias that was deprecated. In some model outputs the tool name tokenization changed slightly and our fuzzy-matcher maps to the wrong tool id.

lukas-eng-platform: Quick check: tool registry shows both expense_lookup_v1 and expense_lookup_v2. v2 schema changed arg shapes (now expects string id). If v3.1 emits numeric ids in tool args (because of new parsing), validation will fail.

maya-support: ACME said it affects a small % of calls but hits high-value paths -> they want rollback until fix.

zoe-eng-ml: Proposed immediate actions:
- rollback v3.1 canary to 0% (stop routing to v3.1) :thumbsup:
- patch fuzzy matcher to prefer exact matches and improve token normalization
- add explicit schema coercion where safe (coerce numbers->strings)

lukas-eng-platform: I can push rollback now. Need approval from oncall/eng lead.

ryan-eng-oncall: Approving rollback, given customer impact and latency. Execute rollback and notify accounts.

lukaS-eng-platform (edited): rollback started — reducing v3.1 canary from 5% -> 0%. Watching routing logs. :eyes:

zoe-eng-ml: After rollback we should run a small repro harness to validate tool selection and arg shapes across model variants. Also add a canary check that runs our tool-calling prompt suite before enabling.

customer-acct-jess: Thanks, please keep us posted. We saw the errors stop ~3m after you said rollback started.

james-support: Noted — closing the immediate escalation once rollback verified. Followups: create a PR for matcher fix, add schema-coercion opt-in, and add canary gating tests. I'll open a support ticket with ACME describing the root cause and mitigation. :white_check_mark:

zoe-eng-ml: Filing follow-up tasks in TICKET-ML-1312 and TICKET-PLAT-498.

ryan-eng-oncall: Postmortem draft will include timeline, hit rate, rollback decision, and mitigations (matcher change + pre-canary test).

james-support: Thanks everyone. If anyone spots residual 400s after rollback ping here.
